h: Teni says finishing school after seven years inspired her song 'Uyo Meyo'
p: Singer Teni has said that graduating after seven years in school inspired her song 'Uyo Meyo', adding that she recorded it while crying. She spoke about the emotional journey in a recent interview.
more: She described the song as a personal milestone.
